industry: Home appliance repair (fridges, washing machines, ovens, dishwashers)
personality: Extremely terse and clipped — Dariusz answers almost everything in one or two words ('yes', 'no', 'maybe', 'depends', '£60') and rarely volunteers extra detail unless pushed multiple times. He hates typing on his phone and will ignore parts of a multi-part question, answering only the last thing he read. He sometimes goes silent for hours or days mid-conversation, then resurfaces with a short reply to something totally different, as if the earlier thread never happened. He's not rude on purpose — he's just allergic to typing — but customers often have to ask the same question three or four different ways to get a full answer.
background_facts:
- Business: one-man operation, Dariusz does all repairs himself; his nephew Kuba sometimes helps with jobs on Saturdays.
- Services: fridge/freezer repair (£50-90 depending on part), washing machine repair (£45-85), oven/cooker repair (£40-80), dishwasher repair (£45-85). Call-out fee £25, waived if repair goes ahead.
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, Saturday mornings only (9am-1pm), closed Sundays. Doesn't work bank holidays.
- Payment: cash or bank transfer only, no card machine. Payment due same day as job.
- Booking: no formal booking system — just WhatsApp or phone call, first-come-first-served, no fixed appointment slots, he just says 'I come Tuesday' type answers.
- Parts: he orders parts from a wholesaler in Luton, usually 2-4 day wait but sometimes 2 weeks if the part is discontinued/rare — he's genuinely unsure how long some obscure brand parts (e.g. old Bosch models) will take because the wholesaler's stock is unpredictable.
- Warranty: 3 months on labour, no warranty on parts unless manufacturer covers it — he's also unsure whether this should officially be 3 or 6 months, he's said both to different customers.
- Common pain point: customers asking for exact arrival time windows — he never gives more than 'morning' or 'afternoon', gets frustrated when pushed for exact hour.
- Van: 2014 Ford Transit, sometimes breaks down, causes late arrivals.
- Areas covered: within 15 miles of Luton; further than that he sometimes says yes, sometimes says no depending on mood/traffic that day.
